breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt incorrectly applied the ideal-gas law to a liquid. The ground truth corrects this by explicitly stating not to use the ideal-gas law and instead to use the known density of water (≈ 998 kg/m^3). The generated specification correctly mirrors this correction by stating, 'Do not apply the ideal-gas law to liquid water' and providing the value '998 kg/m³ for liquid water at 20°C'.
